entities.name: Adrienne van rees Dutilh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adrienne (Adya) van Rees-Dutilh was a Dutch textile artist, painter and graphic artist. She was part of the Dada movement in Zürich and was one of the early signatories of the first Berlin Dada manifesto.
